settings.heading: Care for the things you choose.
settings.body: A little attention helps keep everyday objects at their best.

settings.heading: Start with the product guidance.
settings.body: Read the care label and the instructions supplied with your item. Materials and finishes need different care; check the product page before cleaning or treating them.

settings.heading: Ask before you try.
settings.body: If you are unsure which care method is suitable, contact us with the product name and the detail you would like to know.
